why_ai: Tooling vendors with no licence moat, though adversarial attacks and AI-written code grow demand.
why_clarity: Findings are checkable against code, but which ones truly matter is contested.
why_digital: Code and packages in, findings and policy out, sold online.

why_ai: Signing and attestation are automated build facts, with regulation sustaining demand.
why_clarity: Provenance cryptographically verifies or fails, every build.
why_digital: Build metadata in, signed attestations out.

why_ai: Mining the fleet corpus is ML work, but the outcome-labelled corpus is proprietary.
why_clarity: Exploitability and upgrade estimates are checkable against fleet outcomes over time.
why_digital: Dependency graphs and outcomes in, risk estimates out.

why_ai: Assembling evidence to rank findings is automated analysis AI-native tools target.
why_clarity: Thousands of findings recur nightly, though true priority is confirmed only by exploitation.
why_digital: Scan findings and context in, ranked queues out.

why_ai: Adversaries adapt within days and AI-driven attacks grow demand for detection.
why_clarity: Packages are malicious or not, but novel attacks evade defined methods.
why_digital: Public registry packages in, detections and blocks out.

why_ai: Reachability is program analysis with a precise question that tools and AI answer.
why_clarity: Whether code reaches a vulnerable function is a precise, testable question.
why_digital: Source code and dependencies in, reachability verdicts out.

why_ai: Predicting upgrade breakage from fleet history and tests is automatable with code models.
why_clarity: An upgrade either passes the build and tests or breaks.
why_digital: Code and upgrade history in, breakage predictions out.

why_ai: Structured documents with simple questions are trivially queried by software and AI.
why_clarity: SBOMs are standardised and answers are exact lookups.
why_digital: Structured SBOM files in, answers out.

why_ai: Component identification and vulnerability matching are solved, commoditised capabilities.
why_clarity: Components match database entries exactly, on every scan.

why_ai: Repetitive does-not-apply determinations are exactly what AI triage agents absorb.
why_clarity: The same finding types recur nightly with checkable applicability.
why_digital: Findings and code reviewed entirely on screen.

why_ai: Fixes are frequently determinable, so AI can explain and patch the ticket.
why_clarity: A fix either resolves the vulnerability and passes tests or not.
why_digital: Tickets and code in, patches out.
